text: Accor's shareholders' pact provides for the election of two Accor directors proposed by the Qatar Investment Authority while it holds over 6% of Accor's capital.
short: QIA may propose two Accor directors while it holds over 6%.

source.name: Accor: 2025 Universal Registration Document, shareholders' pact with Qatar Investment Authority (AMF)
source.quote: election to the Accor Board of Directors of two directors proposed by QIA, provided that it holds over 6% of Accor's capital
source.note: The PDF is 19 MB, so scripts/check_sources.py reads only its first 8 MB and cannot extract the quote; opened by hand on 2026-10-02.

additionalSources.name: La Revue des Hôtels: Parvus, Accor’s Leading Shareholder: What Strategy Lies Ahead?
additionalSources.quote: now surpasses the main historical shareholders represented on the board of directors: Kingdom Holding Company (~7%), Qatar Investment Authority (~6.7%), and BlackRock (~5.6%)
